d:
Tune in to this song "Titli Udi Ud Jo Chali" from the super hit movie Suraj (1966) starring Rajendra Kumar and Vyjayanthimala in the lead only on Rajshri.
Movie: Suraj (1966)
Singer: Sharda
Music: Shankar Jaikishan
Lyricist: Shailendra
Cast: Vyjayanthimala, Rajendra Kumar, Ajit, Mumtaz, Johnny Walker
Director: T. Prakash Rao
